structure.unit: Form and Effect of Deeds and Covenants; Liens
Effect of Certain Expressions in Deeds

law.catch_line: Effect of certain transfer fee covenants

text.section: A transfer fee covenant recorded in the Commonwealth on or after July 1, 2011, shall not run with the title to real property and is not binding on, or enforceable at law or in equity against, any subsequent owner, purchaser, or mortgagee of any interest in real property as an equitable servitude or otherwise. Any lien purporting to secure the payment of a transfer fee under a transfer fee covenant recorded in the Commonwealth on or after July 1, 2011, is void and unenforceable.
